name: doc-converter
description: Turns a document into clean Markdown: PDF (text layer), Word, PowerPoint, Excel, CSV, HTML, JSON, XML, EPUB, plain text, or a ZIP of those. Name up to 5 files in your cloud drive or file storage, paste HTML or a CSV, or send a file through the API. The conversion is done in code, so the document's content never reaches a model; the result comes back in a Markdown block you can copy or download, with page, sheet and slide counts and honest warnings (scanned PDF with no text layer, cut sheets). Read-only. It does not summarise, translate, rewrite or answer questions about a document.

skills.name: Convert a document to Markdown
skills.description: A PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, CSV, HTML, JSON, XML, EPUB, text or ZIP file from your cloud drive, file storage, a paste or the API, converted to Markdown in code, with counts and warnings. Say 'as json' for a workflow envelope.
examples: Convert Q3-plan.docx from my Drive to markdown
Turn the deck 'Board update.pptx' in Dropbox into markdown
